changelog: YOU ARE TOLD WHEN A CURSE LANDS. Curses used to arrive in silence — you would find one mid-shuffle with no idea which fight had handed it to you. Every curse now announces itself the moment it enters your deck or your hand, named, so you can answer it. THE SEED PLAQUE keeps its own proportions in landscape instead of being stretched to fill its slot, and the gold lettering sits where the artwork was drawn for it. ALSO ON DESKTOP FOR THE FIRST TIME (it shipped to Android in 0.0.26): the Sacred Wood's deer is a proper quarry — shells, fire and storms pass straight through it, only your soldiers can bring it down, and it slips a picket line instead of backing itself into the map edge.
